responsibility: Defines the unit tests for `VecMap`, checking its core collection behavior: construction from iterators, owned iteration back into `(K, V)` pairs, insertion semantics including replacement of existing values, and key lookup results.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the more feature-rich ordered and transactional map test files, this one is a compact `VecMap` collection suite focused on iterator-based construction, owned iteration back to pairs, insertion with replacement, and key lookup.
